Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.agent

Class StrategyFactory

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.agent.StrategyFactory
public final class StrategyFactory extends Object
Factory translating an AgentState into the matching BehaviorStrategy.

Only the state-driven strategies are produced here (calm, panicked, frozen). LeaderFollowStrategy is intentionally absent: it is not tied to a state and is assigned to an agent explicitly. The AgentState.EXITED state has no behaviour and yields null.
